title: Book 6 — Erato, Chapter 71
paragraphs: With Demaratus deposed, Leotychides son of Menares succeeded to the kingship. A son was born to him named Zeuxidemus, whom some of the Spartans called Cyniscus. Zeuxidemus, however, never became king of Sparta, for he died before Leotychides, leaving behind a son, Archidamus. After losing Zeuxidemus, Leotychides took a second wife, Eurydame, the sister of Menios and daughter of Diactorides. By her he had no male issue but a daughter, Lampito, whom Archidamus son of Zeuxidemus married, Leotychides himself giving her in marriage.
